review.why: Writes technical writer, API documentation and knowledge management resumes with honest claims about validation and impact.
review.summary: Asks about the reader, domain, document types, editorial responsibility and maintained output, and separates writing, editing, information architecture and tooling work. It keeps authorship, editorial ownership and subject-matter approval apart, claims validated examples only if they were validated, and treats readership, search behavior and support contacts as different measures.
strengths: Writing a procedure is not presented as authority to approve its safety
No claimed ticket reduction from page views alone
The resume itself should demonstrate clear writing
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Full writing samples are left to the portfolio skill
